name: Sejal Rekhan
description: Sejal, a Grants Innovation Specialist at Gitcoin's Grants Lab, orchestrates $2M+ grant rounds for open-source projects and leads RPGF rounds with Protocol Labs, POKT, and Celo. Her DAO expertise includes spearheading partnerships at a DAO tooling company and leading the GreenPill Network across 15+ countries. Passionate about decentralized ecosystems, Sejal leverages her experience to consult on and develop impactful grant programs in the Web3 space.
